derivation: each value is a - b over fields of artifacts/pivot/carve_generalisation_2048.json; no model is re-run and no new measurement is made

carve_size_cost_at_matched_rung.meaning: the same training volume at 2048 versus at 4096 - what the shorter window costs, holding data volume fixed

carve_size_gain_over_1024_at_matched_run.meaning: the same training volume at 2048 versus at 1024 (the banked 0007 matched-rung accuracy) - what the longer window buys back, holding data volume fixed

transfer_margin.meaning: a model trained at the LONGER carve, evaluated on the shorter corpus, minus that corpus's own best baseline

transfer_margin_gutenberg_excluded.meaning: the 4096-trained model on 2048-byte fragments minus corpus C's own best preregistered baseline, both on the non-gutenberg rows

within_margin_expanded.meaning: top-1 at the shorter carve minus its best baseline over ALL baselines

within_margin_expanded_gutenberg_exclude.meaning: top-1 at 2048 minus its best baseline over ALL baselines, both scored on the evaluation rows whose source family is not gutenberg - the rows the chunk-id disjointness guarantee covers

within_margin_frozen.meaning: top-1 at the shorter carve minus that corpus's best PREREGISTERED baseline
